stateVariables: financialBoundary.machine: Machine (the sole variable; no Driver/cursor variable)
inputDomain: Q=suppliedInvocations is a finite nonempty list; its first input is StartInput. Every selected input satisfies existing normalDomain. Identity, ActionPlan and guardCosts are the same source context throughout Q. Subsequent invocation inputs are ResumeInput whose continuation equals the immediately preceding returned Waiting continuation. This is a positive observer/cohort relation, not a new production admission policy.
initial: machine=initial(Q.head): current first Invocation, Ready, NoResult, NoPrefix, records=[], observedAttempted=0. Exact unchanged financialBoundary initial relation.

actions.init: Initializes the first supplied Invocation only. Empty queue is outside positive domain and has no initial transition.
actions.publishOnlyWhenReady: Existing publishStep. Appends exactly one complete Record, sets Published and current result/prefix; observedAttempted adds supplied attempted work. No queue-input transition or source work is fused into this action.
actions.advanceInput: Enabled only in Published with a nonempty published prefix shorter than Q. Next Q element is indexed by records.length. Requires previous result Waiting, next input ResumeInput with exactly that returned continuation, and unchanged source context. Existing beginInvocation switches current to next, sets Ready/NoResult/NoPrefix, and preserves records/observedAttempted.
actions.finalStutter: Enabled only after all Q inputs were published. Uses existing terminalStutter preserving the complete Machine exactly. Not selected by the exact finite observation bound.
actions.sequenceStep: Choose publication, advanceInput or finalStutter. Conditions are disjoint, so the admitted selected sequence is deterministic.

invariants: The complete record invocation list is exactly a prefix of Q; no filtering or omitted record.
Ready current is Q[records.length]; Published current is Q[records.length-1]. Bounds are checked before indexing.
Every consecutive Record has exact returned-Waiting-continuation/next-ResumeInput linkage.
First selected input is StartInput; selected source identity/plan/guardCosts context is unchanged.
witness: allInputsPublishedWitness iff phase Published and records.length==Q.length.

observationBound.formula: For N=Q.length>0, maxSteps=2*N-1 from initial Ready; observe all ordered 2*N full Machine states, including Ready input-transition states. Samples1, seed1, explicit TypeScript backend. No terminal stutter is selected; no stutter erasure allowed.
observationBound.selectedInputLengthBasis: N is the Start plus supplied event-file count for this successful finite cohort. No numeric expected state/cost/result cell is provided here. Actual source failure/early terminal remains a mismatch rather than truncating expected data.

owningExpectedRoot.publications: Ordered array of complete producer publication values.

rawB06ExpectedRoot.normalizedMapConvention: Snapshot.state sorted name/value rows; guardCosts sorted site/cost rows; Scenario.state and Scenario.inputs ordinary string-keyed objects
rawB06ExpectedRoot.states: All direct complete Machine objects in original order; no ordinal wrapper.
rawB06ExpectedRoot.commonWires: Complete canonical common observations for each publication record, in input order.

rawWire: Use previously released SAFE complete Machine variants/records; retain actionName. Snapshot.state rows sorted names; guardCosts rows sorted integer site/cost; Scenario.state and Scenario.inputs remain ordinary JSON objects of typed Scalars, including empty objects. All other arrays retain exact order and all fields. Canonical action restoration is only in commonWires.
charges: Publication and input-transition actions are model observation bookkeeping, not new source logical or physical/K/B/helper fuel. Existing supplied runtime/static-cost/admission/emission premises and source committed/attempted distinction remain.
authority: Root treats this as a finite ordinary-case extension under unchanged published production/reference rules/weights/caps, with fresh nonauthor Opus source/op audit before actual checks. Existing B17 adoption/result scope is not rewritten. Independent derivation remains conditional until Root selects/adopts the extended finite scope.
blindBoundary: Independent owner receives this declaration contract/input-only files/body-free semantic contract only; no producer/model implementation/actual/private prior reports. Model/source author receives no populated independent expected outputs.
